Hi Karthik,

We are preparing BluePeak's vendor risk assessment for Q4 and need the most recent penetration test report covering Redwood's Hosted API surface. Specifically:
- Full penetration test report (redacted if required) or an executive summary if full cannot be shared.
- Current remediation status for high/critical findings (list or spreadsheet preferred).
- Any SOC 2 / SIG artifacts that reference the Hosted API scope.

Our security team prefers secure delivery via our Kiteworks instance (upload@bluepeak.kiteworks.com) or an SFTP endpoint that we can provide IP allowlisting for. If those aren’t possible, we can accept a time-limited, encrypted download link (with AES-256) and a delivered passphrase via separate channel.

Can you confirm what you can share, what will be redacted, and an estimated delivery date? Also, please include the contact and key fingerprint if you provide an SFTP upload.

Thanks — we need this for a procurement review next week.

– Julia

Short answer: we can provide an executive summary and a vetted redacted copy of the full penetration test report right away, plus a remediation status spreadsheet showing open/closed items and ETA for any remaining high/critical items. Full, unredacted reports are restricted and require a short transfer approval (NDA / access controls), but many customers accept the redacted copy + evidence extract.

Julia prefers Kiteworks or SFTP with IP allowlist — does Redwood have an SFTP endpoint or a Kiteworks partner we can use for uploads?

Julia — once Laura confirms, we’ll reply with a delivery plan and attach the executive summary and remediation spreadsheet as a starting point. Estimated delivery for redacted report + spreadsheet: EOD tomorrow (9/15).

Karthik / Monica / Julia —

Planning note and handoff: SecOps can produce the following artifacts for BluePeak by EOD 2026-09-15:
1) Executive summary (attached): high-level findings, scope (Hosted API endpoints and management plane), and remediation status.
2) Redacted PDF of the full penetration report — we will redact low-level POC exploit traces, internal IPs, and any customer-specific data.
3) Remediation status spreadsheet (attached) with ticket links, current owners, and ETA for outstanding criticals. Current snapshot: 12 of 14 high/critical items closed; remaining 2 are remediation-in-progress with target close 2026-09-29.

Delivery options we support:
- Secure Kiteworks upload (we can push to BluePeak’s Kiteworks tenancy if they provide a destination address).
- SFTP (secure-managed endpoint) with IP allowlist. We will provide an SSH host key fingerprint and a unique account.
- If neither is acceptable, we can generate a password-protected 7z (AES-256) with the passphrase delivered by phone or a separate email to a different address — link expiry configurable (default 7 days).

Metadata & evidence: we will include a small set of supporting artifacts (remediation Jira links, test scope, and the risk register excerpt). We will NOT include raw exploit code or any red-team tooling output in the redacted version. If BluePeak’s legal/security team requires the full report for a contractual review, we can proceed under a short, mutually-signed data-sharing addendum; that workflow typically takes 2–3 business days.

Attachments: redwood_2026_pen_test_exec_summary_v1.pdf; redwood_remediation_status_q3_2026.xlsx

Julia — please confirm which delivery method you prefer and whether BluePeak needs the full unredacted artifacts (and if so, confirm the point of contact for the data-sharing addendum).

Thanks,
